notes: Final rights-offering prospectus (424B1) dated May 24, 2021 for the Fund's sixth rights offering. Subscription period May 28, 2021 to June 28, 2021 (5:00 p.m. ET), pricing date June 29, 2021, unless extended. Subscription price is 95% of the lower of (i) the average NYSE last sale price on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days and (ii) NAV on the Expiration Date; no NAV floor is stated in this excerpt. Rights are non-transferable and not listed. max_new_shares 8,528,621 is the primary subscription (the text elsewhere says 'approximately'); the Board may issue secondary over-subscription shares of up to 25% of the primary subscription (10,660,776 shares in total with secondary over-subscription, per the dilution table). Rights are rounded up to a multiple of five. Illustrative figures: Estimated Purchase Price $7.69 (95% of NAV $8.09 on May 20, 2021), Estimated Subscription Price for payment $7.90; shares traded at a 14.7% premium to NAV on May 20, 2021; 42,643,103 common shares outstanding as of May 20, 2021. Board approved the offer on March 18, 2021; terms announced March 19, 2021. The Fund undertakes to suspend the offer if NAV declines more than 10% after the effective date.
